result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained sidewalk adjacent to a large mixed-use building. While the pedestrian walkway is spacious and separated from the road by trees and a small planting strip, no formal crossing infrastructure is visible in this specific view.

hazards.name: Lack of visible crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility patterns if this location serves as a pedestrian desire line.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Ensure the installation of directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

result.summary: The street features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and mature street trees, creating a pleasant pedestrian environment. However, there is a notable lack of marked crosswalks and traffic control devices at the visible intersection points.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street may obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with sidewalks and mature trees providing shade. While a curb ramp with tactile paving is present, there are no clearly marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at this junction.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars and a large tree near the corner may block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The absence of high-visibility crosswalk markings may reduce driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.

interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The street provides a shaded pedestrian environment with sidewalks on both sides and mature tree cover that likely encourages lower vehicle speeds. However, the absence of marked crosswalks and the presence of parked cars along the curb create potential visibility hazards for pedestrians wishing to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely within the visible area.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can hide pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers, especially at potential crossing points.

interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians by moving the waiting area past the line of parked cars.
